notes.title: Bug fixes and Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fixes and Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[i]Game experience has been improved[/i]

We’re excited to bring you updates that enhance the overall game experience and add more engaging features!

[b]What's New:[/b] [list] [b]More Music Content:[/b] Added additional music to make gameplay more enjoyable and immersive. [b]Enhanced Multiple Answer Games:[/b] You can now click on shapes in games with multiple answer options, providing a more interactive experience. [*][b]New Achievement – "Artists":[/b] Unlocked when using the whiteboard, encouraging creativity and engagement. [/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] [list] [*][b]Square vs Rectangle Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue in the Geometry game where squares and rectangles were not differentiated correctly. [/list]

Enjoy the updated experience, and thank you for your feedback! Keep playing and watch for more improvements in future updates.

notes.title: Performance update
notes.notes: Multiple performance improvements has been applied.
